processes.name: NONE
processes.data1: No process callback; inspect DamageType
processes.data2: No process callback; inspect DamageType
processes.note: NONE does not disable ordinary projectile damage.

processes.name: CREATE_CREATURE
processes.data1: Creature ID (low u8)
processes.data2: Number to create (signed i32, positive loop bound)
processes.note: Special handling for creature ID 9; created in a ring.

processes.name: CREATE_OBJECT
processes.data1: Object ID (low u8)
processes.data2: Gold amount when created object ID is 1
processes.note: Special handling for object ID 10.

processes.name: MODIFY_HEALTH
processes.data1: Signed health delta (positive heals, capped to missing health)
processes.data2: No read in this process callback
processes.note: Shot ID 43 has a hard-coded 5%-health path; normal damage is a separate dispatcher.

processes.name: MODIFY_SPEED
processes.data1: Speed multiplier in percent (100 = same speed)
processes.data2: Duration seconds, low 16 bits then multiplied by TPS
processes.note: 0x48CAD0 applies speed bounds and a 16-bit timer.

processes.name: MODIFY_ARMOUR
processes.data1: Armour timer raw ticks (low 16 bits)
processes.data2: No read in this process callback
processes.note: Writes creature+0x443 directly; this is not an armour percentage.

processes.name: MODIFY_MANA
processes.data1: Mana amount transferred between target owner and caster
processes.data2: Health delta for target creature
processes.note: Health restoration is capped to missing health.

processes.name: MODIFY_EXPERIENCE_LEVEL
processes.data1: Unsigned selector: >1 gains one level-worth of XP, 0/1 loses it
processes.data2: No read in this process callback
processes.note: Not an arbitrary signed number of levels.

processes.name: MODIFY_HUNGER
processes.data1: No read in this process callback
processes.data2: No read in this process callback
processes.note: Uses HungerFill from creature data/level tables, multiplied by 5.

processes.name: LIGHTNING
processes.data1: Damage magnitude, abs(Data1), doubled on checked terrain flag
processes.data2: No read in this process callback
processes.note: Runtime extra flag 1 can prevent lightning damage.

processes.name: INVUNERABLE
processes.data1: Duration seconds; low 16 bits multiplied by TPS into invulnerability timer
processes.data2: No read in this process callback

processes.name: FREEZE
processes.data1: Duration seconds multiplied by TPS; helper writes freeze timer
processes.data2: No read in this process callback

processes.name: ALARM
processes.data1: No read in this process callback
processes.data2: No read in this process callback
processes.note: Signals alarm using current shot position and owner.

processes.name: TURNCOAT
processes.data1: Duration seconds; low 16 bits multiplied by TPS into turncoat timer
processes.data2: No read in this process callback
processes.note: Also stores shot owner as the temporary allegiance player.

processes.name: CONCEAL
processes.data1: Duration seconds; low 16 bits multiplied by TPS into conceal timer
processes.data2: No read in this process callback

processes.name: CHICKEN
processes.data1: Duration seconds; low 16 bits multiplied by TPS into chicken timer
processes.data2: No read in this process callback
processes.note: Primary flag 0x20000 blocks this process.

processes.name: SCAPEGOAT
processes.data1: Duration seconds; low 16 bits multiplied by TPS into scapegoat timer
processes.data2: No read in this process callback

processes.name: WIND
processes.data1: Integer radius in map cells
processes.data2: Percentage used in distance-dependent damage
processes.note: Radius converted to 4096 coordinate units inside handler.

processes.name: RAISE_DEAD
processes.data1: Creature ID (low u8) to create at dead-body positions
processes.data2: No read in this process callback
processes.note: Deletes processed dead bodies.

processes.name: OBEY
processes.data1: Duration seconds multiplied by TPS into obedient timer
processes.data2: No read in this process callback

processes.name: INVISIBLE
processes.data1: Duration seconds; low 16 bits multiplied by TPS into invisible timer
processes.data2: No read in this process callback

processes.name: FEAR
processes.data1: No read in callback
processes.data2: No read in callback
processes.note: FEAR callback at 0x484940 is a no-op in this image; other damage logic may still run.

processes.name: BOULDER
processes.data1: No read in this process callback
processes.data2: No read in this process callback
processes.note: Creates fixed object ID 0x4A; health/speed use global variables.

processes.name: ALERT
processes.data1: Speed multiplier in percent
processes.data2: Duration seconds; low 16 bits multiplied by TPS
processes.note: Confirmed from assembly, including setter RET 4 and helper RET 8. Decompiled indirect-call stack cleanup was wrong.

processes.name: MESMERISE
processes.data1: No read in this process callback
processes.data2: No read in this process callback
processes.note: Changes target owner to shot owner under checked conditions.

processes.name: SIGHT_OF_EVIL
processes.data1: Nonzero DWORD enables initial event; low u16 is cell-coordinate radius capped at7 by Bridge0D
processes.data2: No read in this process callback
processes.note: Phase77 executes process25→World→Session→Bridge0D→region setup. Data1=65536 enables radius0 event,unlike literal0. Final visible mask/renderer and KeeperC8 purpose remain unproved;see SIGHT_OF_EVIL_RU.md.

processes.name: POSSESS_CREATURE
processes.data1: No read in this process callback
processes.data2: No read in this process callback
processes.note: Possession uses target and player state.

processes.name: TREMOR
processes.data1: Low 16 bits multiplied by TPS for tremor duration
processes.data2: Low 16 bits shifted left 12, then cast to u16; helper caps at 0x5000
processes.note: This is not an unrestricted 32-bit magnitude.

processes.name: GUIDED
processes.data1: No read in this process callback
processes.data2: No read in this process callback
processes.note: Guidance uses shot Speed, target position, angle and elapsed ticks.

processes.name: DECKEM
processes.data1: No read in this process callback
processes.data2: No read in this process callback
processes.note: Uses fixed 0xFF argument to target state routine.

processes.name: INFERNO
processes.data1: Damage, negated for health modification
processes.data2: Integer radius in map cells
processes.note: Damages targets within the checked radius, with special first-tick radius.

processes.name: GAS
processes.data1: No read in this process callback
processes.data2: Integer area extent in cells
processes.note: Normal DamageType may independently read Data1; do not mark it globally unused.

processes.name: TRIGGER
processes.data1: No read in this process callback
processes.data2: No read in this process callback
processes.note: Signals using definition GeneralEffectId; exact triggered system name not inferred.

processes.name: SUMMON_REAPER
processes.data1: Optional reaper lifetime seconds; nonzero changes level selection path
processes.data2: No read in this process callback
processes.note: Creature type and alternate starting level obtained from world/global state.

processes.name: INSTANTANEOUS_HIT
processes.data1: No read in this process callback
processes.data2: No read in this process callback
processes.note: Moves shot to target position and forces collision.

processes.name: DRAIN
processes.data1: Percentage of caster maximum health to drain, capped to target current health
processes.data2: No read in this process callback
processes.note: Percentage basis is caster maximum health, not target maximum health.

processes.name: CREATE_SINGLE_CREATURE
processes.data1: Creature ID (low u8)
processes.data2: Starting level: creates level 1 then repeats level-up while level < Data2
processes.note: Special handling for creature ID 9; low/negative values do not produce level zero.

processes.name: WEB_AREA_EFFECT
processes.data1: Duration seconds, low 16 bits passed to speed modifier
processes.data2: Integer radius in map cells
processes.note: Fixed speed multiplier -90; helper multiplies duration by TPS and applies speed bounds.

processes.name: POISON_SPIT
processes.data1: Poison duration: low u16 update count; stored directly in Creature45D without multiplication by TPS.
processes.data2: Poison damage magnitude per eligible Creature update: low u16; stored in Creature45F.
processes.note: Corrected phase115:4B0270 pushes Data1 first and Data2 second;48CC50 reads ESP+8 into timer45D,ESP+4 into severity45F. Whole native cast/collision/tick confirms50/5 -> timer50,damage5.

processes.data2: Entity tag ID (low u16), used to index live entities
